title: Design System: Noventis Digital
scope: Public world only: src/public.css scoped under .pub, used by HomePage, LabsPage and PrivacyPage, plus the credentials deck at slide scale (the deck still carries the morning build). The portal and admin UI (src/secure.css, PortalPage, AdminPage, components/admin) keep an older dark system and are out of scope. Tokens live on .pub, not :root, so component snippets below resolve to literal values. Recorded 16 October 2026 late evening from the three-routes homepage (terminal, table, diagram on one clock with no foot; copper as the one accent, meaning John); the exploded Item 01 record is superseded and its source archived under .impeccable/archive/catalogue-item01-2026-10-16/.

display.purpose: The session headline only, in log lettering, Archivo condensed to 88%. 52px is the session's display step (new 16 October evening). Floors at 34px on a phone; no ch limit, the column sets the measure.

headline.purpose: Section heads (The routes, Running today, The person, Send a note) and the Labs head at 88% width. The Privacy title uses the same voice at 34px.

title.purpose: Route row titles, the person's opening line, the sent plate title, policy section heads at 18px. The diagram's name box sets John Byrne at 600, 15px, ink on copper.

lead.purpose: The paragraph beside the headline inside the session, log muted, max 52ch.

request.purpose: The request cell of the notation table at 500; 14.4px inside the diagram's boxes.

body.purpose: Root size on .pub with tabular figures. Route row lines, prose on plates, policy prose, the phone list's request line.

table.purpose: Specification values at 500 with row heads at 400 muted; the rules table reverses it (heads 600 ink, lines 400 soft).

note.purpose: The session credit line, the Also running note, form note, policy meta, colophon. The phone list's on-call line is the same size in lettering.

session-bar.purpose: Uppercase, log muted. The two ends of the session's top bar: NOVENTIS · SESSION and AI TRANSFORMATION EXPERTISE.

label.purpose: Uppercase. Section head labels in soft ink (Pick yours, Client portal, One person, Enquiry form); inside the notation the column heads Request, Route, On call, the diagram route labels and the hover destination at 0.6875em in log muted; form field names at 0.12em.

caption.purpose: Uppercase. The line at the foot of every light plate and the proof caption under each route row, muted ink.

number.purpose: Uppercase, Archivo expanded to 125%, ink. Route numbers on the routes plate (01 Build) and the Labs item number. Not copper: copper on white failed contrast at 12px.

route-path.purpose: Archivo expanded to 125%. The /build, /adopt, /run cell in the notation table. In the diagram it becomes an 11px uppercase label at 100% width. The table's On call cell (24/7) is 15px in copper.

flag.purpose: Uppercase, inside a 1px ink border. Sent, Not sent.

action.purpose: Uppercase. Buttons at 13px; the index at 12px.

index.purpose: Uppercase. The header index links: Build, Adopt, Run, John, Send a note.

wordmark.purpose: NOVENTIS at 100% width, uppercase, 0.28em, with the 12.5px descriptor beneath in soft ink. The original lockup, not expanded.

mono.purpose: The terminal notation only, at 0.875em of the notation's 16px base (13px on a phone). Commands and on-call: in lettering, comments in log muted, hello@noventis in copper.

shadows.name: plate-cast
shadows.purpose: Every plate, light or dark, at rest and in every state. The notation inside the session carries none.

shadows.name: plate-cast-slide
shadows.purpose: The deck's plates at 1920 by 1080 slide scale.

shadows.name: copper-ring
shadows.purpose: The flat pale ring around the wordmark's 10px copper dot. Lockup artwork, not elevation. Copper elsewhere is flat: no ring, glow or shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every element; 1px offset inside inputs.

shadows.name: row-wash
shadows.purpose: Hover on a notation row in the table view: a 6% wash of lettering, not a hue.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Button inversion, link underline and input border colour.

motion.name: ease-notation
motion.purpose: The notation's cells changing left, width, height, top, face and type between terminal, table and diagram. Theme colours on the notation use the same duration.

motion.name: stagger-row
motion.purpose: Transition delay on each notation row, so the three redraw top to bottom.

motion.name: fade-text
motion.purpose: Crossfade between a cell's per-notation texts; cell opacity 0.45s; column heads 0.35s.

motion.name: type-terminal
motion.value: clip-path inset 0.6s steps(20, end); command at i*0.6s + 0.15s, comment + 0.55s, on-call line + 0.85s
motion.purpose: The terminal's lines typing in on first arrival only (.rt--first). Later returns to the terminal morph from held positions with no blank frame.

motion.name: draw-line
motion.purpose: The diagram's arrows drawing by stroke-dashoffset after the boxes have moved.

motion.name: blink-cursor
motion.purpose: The terminal's copper block cursor after the last line.

motion.name: clock-notation
motion.purpose: Period of the one clock: terminal, table, diagram. The only driver; no notation selector, no status word. Pointer entry or focus pauses it; the Pause word stops it until Play. Off under reduced motion and at or below 980px.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Single column; session paddings 18px; notation becomes the terminal as a static list of three lines per route at 13px mono with no clock, heads, lines or foot; route rows stack; wordmark descriptor hidden; side padding 18px.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Form grid becomes one column. The display size reaches its 34px floor through the clamp alone.

layout.container: 1360px max, 40px side padding (18px at or below 980px)
layout.session: 24px under the header; bar 12px 24px; top 1.1fr : 1fr with 48px gap at 36px 24px 28px; notation inset 8px; foot 16px 24px; rules in log-key; ends at about 735px at 1440 by 900
layout.notation: 16px base; 2.6em column head; three rows of 5.4em; stage inset 1em with 0.8em below and the last rule transparent; no foot; table columns 52% 18% 30%; cells at 0-50%, 52-68%, 70-100%; diagram request box ends at 46%, name box starts at 68% on the middle row; terminal command 0-34% and comment 34-100% at 30%, on-call line 0-60% at 72%
layout.spread: 7fr : 5fr with a 56px gutter for Running today; the enquiry section 5fr : 7fr; the person 220px : 1fr with 40px
layout.section: 48px vertical padding, 1px keyline on top, 16px scroll margin
layout.routes: one plate, three rows of 110px : 5fr : 7fr, 28px gaps, 20px 22px padding, soft keyline between

narrative.overview:
The site is a product catalogue and the products are the software. The catalogue opens with a session: its one dark plate, grown to fill the first screen, with the headline set inside it and the offer written as three routes to one person. The same three lines are shown as a terminal, a table and a diagram, redrawn on one clock while the rows hold their place. Below the session the catalogue resumes: the three routes as numbered rows on one plate, the software that is running today on a plate with its specification table, the person by name and face with his four rules as a spec table, and a form. The reference is the British industrial-design catalogue (Anglepoise, Dualit): a flat grey page, objects photographed on white, a line of small capitals under each one.

The page is one studio-grey ground from top to bottom. Nothing sits on a white band. Every object is a plate with a 1px border and the same soft downward cast shadow, as if laid on a works-office desk in daylight. One plate is dark, the session, and inside it the palette inverts: lettering on log, rules in log-key, the pressed state swapping lettering and log. One accent, copper, with one meaning: it marks John and the way to him. The copper dot in the wordmark, "hello@noventis" in the terminal and "24/7" in the table in the terminal and the table, the diagram's name box, the terminal cursor and the two Send a note buttons are copper; everything else is ink and grey, and state still inverts rather than changing hue. One type family, Archivo, does every job by changing width: expanded for numbers and route paths, condensed for headlines, normal for everything else. Monospace appears in one place, the terminal notation.

Confirmed rejections: the category arrangement (headline over sub-copy and a button, a row of equal service cards); the carousel of three finished pictures; any costume from the client's shop floor (the planning board of 15 October 2026); the quiet hairline studio sketch (judged generic); the earlier restrained dark theme (judged a generic Claude design).
keyCharacteristics: One studio-grey ground across the whole page, never a white band.
One dark plate, the session, at the top; every other object a white plate with a 1px keyline, cast shadow and caption at the foot.
Three routes to one person: three rows that keep their place while the notation around them redraws on one clock.
One accent, copper, only on John and the way to him; state inverts and, where it is shown, is written in words (Sent, Not sent, Sending).
One family across widths (Archivo 88 to 125); tabular figures everywhere; monospace only in the terminal notation.
Nothing rounds beyond the copper dot; nothing glows.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: The page is `ground` from the top of the header to the bottom of the colophon. Sections are separated by a 1px keyline, never by a change of background. The only dark fields are the session plate and the Labs experiment, and both are plates on the ground, not bands.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: State is never a hue. Hover, pressed and active leave copper for the plate's own pair. The Send a note button is copper with ink type everywhere; on the ground it goes to ink with ground type on hover, inside the session to lettering with log type. Copper is never a hover or pressed colour; it is a resting mark.

rules.name: The Copper Means John Rule
rules.body: Copper is the one accent and it has one meaning: John, and the way to him. It sits on the wordmark's dot, on "hello@noventis" in the terminal and "24/7" in the table and John Byrne's box in the notation, on the terminal cursor and on the two Send a note buttons. Do not spend it on headings, links, rules, numbers, icons or decoration, and never set it as small text on white; if a copper mark does not point at John, it is wrong.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo is the only typeface on the public world. Expanded (125%) is reserved for item numbers, route numbers and route paths; condensed (88%) for the display and headlines; everything else is 100%. Monospace appears only in the terminal notation.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every automation states when it runs, as a tabular time ("Mondays, 07:30", "02:00 nightly, kept 30 days"). Figures are tabular on the root, so times, prices and counts align in every table.

rules.name: The State in Words Rule
rules.body: When state is shown it is written, not coloured. The form says Sending, Sent or Not sent in a flag or a button label; the hover on a notation row shows the route's name as a word. The notation itself shows no state at all: no caption, no status word, no control.

rules.name: The Cast Shadow Rule
rules.body: A plate's shadow is the same whether it is resting, hovered or pressed. Shadows describe where the object sits on the desk; they never signal state.

dos: Do keep the whole page on the studio-grey ground and put every object on a plate with a 1px border, the plate cast shadow and a caption at its foot.
Do keep one dark plate at the top, the session, and invert its palette consistently: lettering on log, rules in log-key, the button's hover as lettering with log type.
Do spend copper only on John and the way to him: the dot, "hello@noventis" in the terminal and "24/7" in the table, the name box, the cursor, the two Send a note buttons.
Do number items and routes in the expanded number voice (Archivo 125%, 700, 12px, 0.14em) and set the display and headlines condensed (88%).
Do write state as a word where it is shown (Sent, Not sent, Sending) and invert for the active or pressed state.
Do give every automation a tabular time for when it runs.

Do run all motion off one clock, pause it on hover or focus and stop it from the Pause word, type the terminal in once on first arrival only, rest still on the terminal under reduced motion, and show the static terminal list at or below 980px.
Do keep the wordmark as the original lockup: copper dot in its flat ring, NOVENTIS at 100% width tracked 0.28em, descriptor beneath.
donts: Don't add a second accent, and don't put copper on anything that is not John or the way to him: no copper headings, links, rules, numbers, hover states or decoration, and no copper text on white.
Don't introduce a white band, a tinted section or a dark page field; dark is a plate on the ground (the session, the Labs experiment).
Don't arrange the routes as three equal cards; they are three numbered rows on one plate.
Don't round a corner other than the copper dot, and don't add glows, lifted hover shadows or a second shadow depth.
Don't use a second type family or a monospace outside the terminal notation.
Don't signal state by colour alone or by a hue change.
Don't let the notation's rows move when the notation changes; the cells redraw, the rows stay.
Don't add a notation selector, caption or status word to the notation; the clock drives it, hover or focus pauses it, and Pause is the only control.
Don't call John a handler anywhere on the surface; the third column is On call and the line reads on-call: hello@noventis.
